data.gender_notes: Pearle is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Pearle is derived from the English word 'pearl', which symbolizes purity, beauty, and rarity. Pearls are formed in oysters from tiny grains of sand, which undergo a process of transformation and become precious gems. In Christianity, pearls are used as a symbol of the kingdom of heaven, which is compared to a pearl of great price in the Bible (Matthew 13:46).
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of the divine and the preciousness of the soul.
data.etymology: Pearle belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Precious jewel.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Pearle total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
